name: galley-js
description: npm workspace root for the npm-built Galley adapters: one install links core, node, bun, and wasm, built core-first by dependency order. The deno adapter stays out (workspace membership flips Deno into npm-linking mode) and its npm dist builds via --prefix after core; the universal package installs standalone.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sanbus/galley-core && npm run build -w @sanbus/galley-node -w @sanbus/galley-bun -w @sanbus/galley-wasm && npm run build --prefix ./deno
